QuestInfo.name: Knight's Orientation
QuestInfo.0: You have reached the Knight's Orientation. Talk to Kimu.
QuestInfo.1: Talk with Training Instructor Kiku. Click the NPC button on the minimap if you need to find him.
QuestInfo.2: You found Training Instructor Kiku amongst the crowd.

1.0: What? #p1102101# sent you down, eh? You must be my new recruit! The name's #p1102000#, and I'll be doing all your thinking for you for a while.

yes.0: I wish they'd start sending over some decent sized fighters, but I guess you'll work.

npc.0: Having a hard time finding Kiku? Have you tried the NPC button up there in the top left, next to the map? You can get a whole list of people around here. Just click on Kiku and you'll see an arrow!
